# MR Living Capital — UAE Real Estate Investment Advisory

> Independent, data-driven real estate investment intelligence across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah.

## Positioning

MR Living Capital is an independent real estate investment advisory built on 35 years in Dubai, own-money investing across three countries and three continents, and first-hand strategy design and implementation.

The advisory does not sell properties. It designs capital strategies that may use real estate as the vehicle. Each engagement begins with the client’s objectives, liquidity needs, risk tolerance and time horizon.

## Services

- Real estate investment advisory and portfolio strategy.
- Corridor-level market intelligence and comparative research.
- Ready and off-plan purchase analysis, including costs, risks and exit considerations.
- Residency-related property guidance, including the AED 2 million Golden Visa route. Eligibility is conditional and subject to current authority requirements; it is not automatic with every purchase.

## Content policy

Research is general market intelligence, not personalised financial, legal, tax or immigration advice. Regulatory, financing and residency eligibility depends on the investor, property and current authority requirements. Verify transaction-specific requirements with the relevant UAE authorities and qualified professionals.

Crawler preferences are published at https://mrlivingcapital.com/robots.txt. User-invoked access remains available under those rules; selected training crawlers are restricted.
